latestTerminalSummary:
Completed the assigned reviser stage and completed the single native Goal. The final proposal, source map, and evidence index are saved in the assigned stage directory:

- [final.md](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B09-P01-control/run/B09-P01-control/stages/reviser/final.md)
- [source-map.json](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B09-P01-control/run/B09-P01-control/stages/reviser/source-map.json)
- [sources/index.md](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B09-P01-control/run/B09-P01-control/stages/reviser/sources/index.md)

The revision clarifies that Koha bundles require barcoded child records, while its manual also documents an override for individual checkout and a way to skip return verification. [Koha circulation manual](https://koha-community.org/manual/latest/en/html/circulation.html), [Koha cataloging manual](https://koha-community.org/manual/latest/en/html/cataloging.html). It confirms Snipe-IT’s status-sensitive check-in predicate but leaves the actual UI/API transition order unresolved; no defect is claimed. [Snipe-IT v8.8.0 Asset model](https://github.com/grokability/snipe-it/blob/v8.8.0/app/Models/Asset.php)

The exact activation and completion responses are saved as [native-goal-active.json](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B09-P01-control/run/B09-P01-control/stages/reviser/native-goal-active.json) and [native-goal-terminal.json](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B09-P01-control/run/B09-P01-control/stages/reviser/native-goal-terminal.json). The Goal completed in 8m 27s (160,689 tokens used).
